scope: Installed environment; CLI help/create/check/audit/report only. No fresh install, solver, path, numerical-accuracy or UI verification.

cases.name: top_level_help
cases.stdout:
usage: nanodesign [-h]
                  {candidate,check,calculate,audit,benchmark,compare-methods,campaign-create,campaign-run,campaign-report,characterize} ...

Quantum-chemistry research for positional diamondoid assembly.

positional arguments:
  {candidate,check,calculate,audit,benchmark,compare-methods,campaign-create,campaign-run,campaign-report,characterize}
    candidate           Generate an explicit diamondoid H-abstraction
                        structure.
    check               Check geometry, charge/spin and mechanical boundary
                        input.
    calculate           Run actual DFT; outputs never overwrite a prior run.
    audit               Show numerical status and missing physical validation.
    benchmark           Compare energies at published reference geometries;
                        this is not a calibrated tool prediction.
    compare-methods     Compare DFT and CCSD(T) at identical small reference
                        geometries and basis.
    campaign-create     Snapshot a finite pose grid or existing designs; no
                        quantum jobs are launched.
    campaign-run        Run a bounded number of jobs, preserving every
                        attempt.
    campaign-report     Read campaign evidence without choosing an unvalidated
                        winner.
    characterize        Compute free-coordinate vibrational modes at a
                        proposed stationary structure.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

cases.name: help_benchmark

                            [--reference-dir REFERENCE_DIR]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

cases.name: help_compare-methods
cases.stdout:
usage: nanodesign compare-methods [-h] --out OUT
                                  [--reference-dir REFERENCE_DIR]
                                  [--basis BASIS]
                                  [--cc-initial-guess {minao,atom,1e,huckel}]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --out OUT
  --reference-dir REFERENCE_DIR
  --basis BASIS         Currently cc-pVDZ only; coupled-cluster calculations
                        are expensive
  --cc-initial-guess {minao,atom,1e,huckel}
                        Explicit HF starting guess; different converged
                        solutions can give different reference energies

cases.stdout:
usage: nanodesign campaign-create [-h] --out OUT
                                  [--separations SEPARATIONS [SEPARATIONS ...]]

  --steps STEPS
  --images IMAGES

cases.name: help_characterize
cases.stdout:
usage: nanodesign characterize [-h] --structure STRUCTURE [--image IMAGE]
                               --out OUT [--step STEP] [--fmax FMAX]
                               [--frequency-tolerance FREQUENCY_TOLERANCE]
                               [--max-free-coordinates MAX_FREE_COORDINATES]
                               design

positional arguments:
  design

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --structure STRUCTURE
                        Optimized structure or trajectory; coordinates in Å
  --image IMAGE         Trajectory frame, default final frame
  --out OUT
  --step STEP           Central-difference displacement in Å
  --fmax FMAX
  --frequency-tolerance FREQUENCY_TOLERANCE
                        Unresolved-mode threshold in cm^-1
  --max-free-coordinates MAX_FREE_COORDINATES
                        Cost guard: each free coordinate requires two quantum
                        force evaluations
